tasks.label: Kill Discord Bot
args: Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'bot\.py' }; if ($procs) { $procs | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force } }

tasks.label: Reload Discord Bot
args: Set-Location '${workspaceFolder}'; $procs = Get-CimInstance Win32_Process | Where-Object { $_.Name -eq 'python.exe' -and $_.CommandLine -match 'bot\.py' }; if ($procs) { $procs | ForEach-Object { Stop-Process -Id $_.ProcessId -Force } ; Start-Sleep -Seconds 1; }; Start-Process -FilePath '.\.venv\Scripts\python.exe' -ArgumentList 'bot.py' -WorkingDirectory '${workspaceFolder}';
